michelle_sales: Quick sync - ACME asked for a single doc that covers: SAML attributes + cert rotation, SCIM lifecycle & rate limits for ~50k users, RBAC group->role semantics, domain verification options, and a 3-month Dedicated POC pricing quote. Can we get one consolidated reply by EOD?

devon_se: I can do the SAML + RBAC pieces. TL;DR: NameID must be email, we accept attributes `email`, `givenName`, `familyName`, `groups`. We support SP & IdP flows. Cert rotation: upload new metadata before expiry; hot-swap is supported.

claire_security: Security side: require assertion signing alg SHA256 (rsa-sha256). Assertion TTL recommendation <=5m. We also support OIDC in case they prefer it. For Dedicated BYOK: KMS integration available.

jonathan_support: SCIM note: initial bulk import then delta polling is best. Hosted default SCIM: 10 requests/min; Dedicated configurable (we've done 100-200/min for customers). For deprovisioning ensure SCIM `active` flag is used.

rachel_pricing: Pricing: two options for the 3-month POC - (A) Monthly-commit Dedicated (standard price) or (B) Time-limited POC discount (3-month contract, reduced commit, no long-term lock). Need their expected peak concurrency and monthly token estimate to size GPUs.

legal_qa: Legal asks: do we have a DPA + EU data residency option? For EU-only they want Dedicated in eu-west-1 + BYOK and signed DPA. Confirmed?

claire_security: Yes on Dedicated eu-west-1 + BYOK. We have a standard DPA; I'll attach the SOC2/ISO snippets.

michelle_sales: Can someone paste the minimal SCIM PATCH example and a SAML attribute snippet I can send?

devon_se: SCIM PATCH (group add) snippet: `PATCH /scim/Groups/{id} {"Operations":[{"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-123","display":"jane@acme.com"}]}]}`

jonathan_support: SAML attribute example (excerpt): `<saml:Attribute Name="groups"><saml:AttributeValue>eng</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>`

michelle_sales: Perfect. Action items: (1) I'll ask ACME for IdP metadata + sample assertion, group list, concurrency + token estimate, and EU-only requirement. (2) @rachel_pricing to draft the two POC pricing options. (3) @claire_security to attach DPA + SOC2 blurbs.

ops_bot: ops-bot: created presales task PRESALES-4402 (ACME identity bundle) - checklist populated. :white_check_mark:

michelle_sales: Thanks team — I'll assemble and send to ACME and book follow-up. :pray:
